title: NotificationEvent
description: device -> server, plain HTTP POST (not over the device WebSocket) from the Event Channel (design doc D-20/§6.1: `services/channel/*` observes notification events and POSTs them outbound to a configured endpoint). Not part of the hello/welcome/step/result/error handshake family, so it carries no `type` discriminator of its own — it is the only message this endpoint accepts. The exact payload shape is this repo's own addition: the design doc names the Event Channel's existence but never specified its wire shape.

package.description: The posting app's package name, e.g. com.whatsapp.

sender.description: The notification's title — usually the contact/sender name.
